items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Willie Humphrey is identified by the interviewer in a photo context ('And there's Willie Humphrey') and mentioned in conversation about records, but the interviewee does not describe a personal or professional relationship with him.

ctx.x: That was the bar, that's Cindy Davila. Oh yeah, Cindy Davila.

And the trombone behind him? Oh, Wendell Eugene. And there's Willie Humphrey. Willie Humphrey. And this is Lizzie. Lizzie. And who's this on trumpet? Talking about Jefferson. Oh yeah, Thomas Jefferson. That's Thomas Jefferson. That was a wild one.
That's Frederick Coleman himself. And who's on bass? And that's Clement. Clement Camelot. Oh, Clement. He wasn't as heavy then.

items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: You know, when I went in there sometime, Willie Humphrey would be there with you. ... Well, I'm happy to play some chimes, which I mean he wouldn't ever mention that he played with such a small musician like me, you know. ... Yeah, but I was there. I remember.

ctx.x: Little Willie, you didn't know Little Willie? Got killed in the bathroom?
Oh, Little Willie, the pianist. Yeah. Yeah. Let me get those people out of his name. Yeah, yeah, that's right.
